steps.code:
# We'll loop: check current song, if not liked, go to next song.
liked_ids = {song['song_id'] for song in apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=access_token)}
current = apis.spotify.show_current_song(access_token=access_token)
while current['song_id'] not in liked_ids:
    apis.spotify.next_song(access_token=access_token)
    current = apis.spotify.show_current_song(access_token=access_token)
print(current)
